name: Empty background changes palette

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-2, 2026-11-26): a long kinetic-type reel opens and closes a quiet section by changing the colour of the empty background.

technique: With nothing on screen, the background itself slowly changes colour (dark to light), so a new emotional register begins without a cut or a wipe; the reverse move closes it.
purpose: Start a new emotional register without a cut or a wipe; the reverse move closes it.
visual_behaviour: The previous content fades out; with nothing on screen the background itself turns from black to warm cream over about half a second (with its vignette), a persistent header stays; the first line of the new section enters after the lift. The section closes with the reverse move over 0.8 s.
mechanics: Previous content fades out first (ref-58ff9f39df 120.77-120.93 s); the empty background tweens black to warm cream with a vignette over 0.6 s, ease-in-out (120.97-121.6 s); the persistent header stays; the first line of the new section enters after the lift. Close: cream to black over 0.8 s with an empty frame (137.5-138.3 s).

decomposition.timing: 0.6-0.8 s per lift; frame empty during the lift.

use_cases: A quote or confession in its own palette
An editorial-light film entering a dark verdict section
failure_modes: Content still on screen during the lift looks like a fade bug
A lift under about 0.3 s reads as a flash

implementation.approach: Fade the outgoing group first; then tween a CSS custom property for the background colour on #root (power1.inOut, 0.6 s) while the frame is empty; enter the next line after the tween. Not built as a named transition.

provenance.observed: The empty black stage lifts to cream over 0.6 s to open a quiet section and sinks back over 0.8 s to close it.
On a held paper-theatre stage the sky colour turns night, day, dusk once per second (each change about 0.3 s, 34-39 s): days pass without a cut.
